items.label: Figure 2
items.caption:
Figure 2. The framework of YOLO-Master. The architecture integrates ES-MoE modules into the Backbone and Neck for enhanced feature
extraction and fusion. Input features are processed through a Dynamic Routing Network with Softmax Gating, selecting top-K experts for
weighted aggregation. The framework adaptively switches between Standard, Soft Top-K (training), and Hard Top-K (inference) routing
strategies for efficient multi-scale object detection across P3, P4, and P5 prediction layers.
